what kind of college is sdit
response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology (SDIT), Kenjar Mangalore, is a premier institution dedicated to excellence in engineering education and holistic development. Established in 2006, SDIT is affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) and recognized by AICTE. The institution offers B.E, M.Tech, MBA, MCA and PhD programs in an environment that fosters innovation, creativity, and leadership. The campus features state-of-the-art laboratories, modern infrastructure, experienced faculty, and a strong placement cell with industry partnerships.

response: SDIT offers the following programs: B.E in Computer Science & Engineering, CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning), Information Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Aeronautical Engineering. Postgraduate programs include M.Tech in Construction Technology, MBA (with dual specialisations), and MCA. A Research Centre for PhD is also available. CET Code: E146, PGCET codes: MBA - B281, MCA - C476, M.Tech - T868.
